rubric.criterion: The formatter configuration owns Tailwind class ordering rather than documentation or manual editing instructions.
Tailwind sorting reads the supplied Tailwind v4 stylesheet.
Class strings passed through the repository's cn and cva helpers are included in formatter sorting.
The existing format and format-check scripts remain the single write and CI verification paths.
The solution adds no second formatter, Tailwind lint rule, editor-only workaround, or manual class sorter.
